verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents itself as open source that you can run on your own server. Its install docs cover Docker Compose, a Kubernetes Helm chart, PostgreSQL and optional Valkey requirements, and upgrades with automatic migrations. Several hands-on community users independently confirm self-hosting it reliably; one notes some deployment friction, which does not contradict the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: It's also open source, so you can view, modify, and use the code as you see fit. Run it on your server, or let us host it for you.
A Helm chart is available for Kubernetes.
GlitchTip requires PostgreSQL (14+) and a single service (or separate web and worker services for scaling). Valkey (or redis) 7+ is optional.
A happy GlitchTip user of about a year finds it super easy to self-host.
